messages:
Miriam: Heads-up — overnight change window at 00:30 UTC. Need final pin freeze, rollback owner, deploy-bot phase plan, and link to release notes.
Sam: Pin list attached. core-models -> v3.4.1, runtime-image -> r2026.03, edge-agent -> 2.1.4. DO NOT unpin during window. :lock:
Alex: I'll take rollback pager. Command we'll use: `./ops/rollback --tag v3.4.0 --reason canary-failure`. I'll escalate to #incidents if triggered.
deploy-bot: Canary schedule created -> region=us-east-1, variant=v3.4.1-canary, phases=[5%,20%,50%], dwell=10m per phase.
deploy-bot: Preflight healthchecks: certs ok, infra green, deploy-queue empty.
Nina: Staging + smoke results: passed. Perf snapshot: p95 ~ 430ms (1kb), embedding throughput ~94% of baseline (small dip). Logging in notes.
Jordan: Release notes published: https://redwood-internal/notes/2026-03-20-v3.4. Callout for embedding quantization regression and mitigation steps.
Miriam: Suggestion: Gate embedding quantization behind runtime flag `feature.embed_quant_v3` (default OFF). If cost/throughput regresses, flip flag instead of full rollback.
Sam: Confirmed flag exists and hot-toggleable via runtime config. I'll stage the toggle and a revert script.
Alex: Playbook: If p50 > 800ms OR error_rate(5m) > 1% OR 5xx_rate spike sustained >3m => pause deploy + execute rollback. I'll run the rollback and notify.
deploy-bot: Safety rule applied: `pause_if(error_rate(2m) > 0.01 or p50 > 0.8s)`. Alert hooks wired to oncall.
Nina: I'll run manual embedding verification at end of each phase using sample set "B" and report results here.
Sam: Ops note: autoscaler locked for 3h post-deploy, edge-agent pinned on edge-nodes. No infra changes during window.
Miriam: I'll post final T-15m metrics snapshot and the go/hold decision. Who will post the launch blurb to #general? Jordan?
Jordan: I'll post a short note to #general after Miriam posts the go (one-liner + changelog link). :rocket:
Miriam: All right — pins frozen, rollback owner set (Alex), runtime flag ready, safety policies live, staging perf acceptable. Proceeding to start canary at T0.
deploy-bot: Canary started — phase=1 (5%). Monitoring enabled (latency, errors, cost delta).
deploy-bot: Phase 1 health (5m): ok=500/505, 2xx=99.1%, 5xx=0.2%
Nina: Phase1 embedding checks ok on sample B. No regressions in output quality observed.
Sam: Infra stable, no scaling events. Flag remains OFF.
Alex: Pager active, standing by for rollback signal.
Miriam: Keep updates concise here. We'll evaluate at phase boundaries and decide on flag flip only if cost delta >10% and quality unchanged. I'll be back with T+10m update.
deploy-bot: Advancing to phase=2 (20%).
deploy-bot: Phase2 health (10m): ok=1200/1210, 2xx=99.3%, 5xx=0.1%
Nina: Phase2 embed validation: throughput still slightly down (~93%), quality checks pass.
Sam: No infra alarms. Cost delta reported to monitoring: +7% for embedding workload.
Miriam: Since cost delta <10% and quality OK, keep flag OFF. Proceed to phase3.
deploy-bot: Advancing to phase=3 (50%).
deploy-bot: Phase3 health (10m): ok=3000/3010, 2xx=99.2%, 5xx=0.15%
Nina: Phase3 embedding sample results: still acceptable. No semantic drift detected.
Sam: Cost delta now +9%. Still under threshold. Autoscaler showing margin.
Miriam: Decision: do NOT flip flag. No rollback. Monitoring continues for 1h. Jordan, stand ready to publish launch blurb when I give the green.
Jordan: Ready. Will post once you confirm.
Alex: Marking incident channel watchers. If anything crosses thresholds I'll flip the rollback script.
Miriam: Final note: post-deploy observation window 1h, owners: eng-releases for deploy, infra for autoscaling, nina for embeddings metrics. Thanks team. Miriam signing off for now — will rejoin for T+30m check-in.
